map.根据 JSON 数据自动生成 JSON Schema，支持类型推断、必填字段、数: Automatically generate a JSON Schema from JSON data, with type inference, required fields, array-item inference and multi-version output.
map.由示例 JSON 推断生成 JSON Schema。: Infer and generate a JSON Schema from sample JSON.
map.：根据出现的键、值类型与出现频率生成 type、properties 与 req: : generate type, properties and required from the keys, value types and frequencies observed.
map.：在所有样本中都出现的键才会被判定为必填。: : only keys present in every sample are marked as required.
map.：元素类型由所有元素推断，混合类型可用 anyOf/oneOf 表达。: : element types are inferred from all elements, and mixed types can be expressed with anyOf/oneOf.
map.：结果为草稿，格式约束（format、pattern、数值范围）需人工补充。: : the result is a draft; format constraints (format, pattern, numeric ranges) must be added manually.
map.给接口先补一份契约：从真实响应样本生成初版 Schema，团队评审后作为前后端联: Give an API a contract up front: generate an initial Schema from a real response sample, have the team review it, and use it as the basis for front-end/back-end integration.
map.样例 `{\"name\":\"Tom\",\"age\":20}` → Sch: Sample `{"name":"Tom","age":20}` → the Schema marks name:string and age:integer.
map.基于样例，极端情况需人工补充约束。: It is based on the sample; edge cases need constraints added manually.
map.为什么推断出来的类型不准？: Why can the inferred types be inaccurate?
map.因为只有一份样本：字段恰好为 null 会被推断成 null 类型，数字 1 无: Because there is only one sample: a field that happens to be null is inferred as the null type, the number 1 cannot be distinguished as integer or float, and an empty array reveals nothing about element type. The fix is to merge multiple samples for inference, then add business constraints such as required, format and value ranges by hand.
map.JSON Schema 生成器。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，代码不离开: JSON Schema Generator. An online tool built for developers, running entirely in the browser; your code never leaves the device.
map.由样例数据递归推断 Schema：null 得 type=「null」；数组得: Infer the schema recursively from sample data: null gives type “null”; an array gives type “array”, and when non-empty each element is inferred recursively and merged into items; a string gives type “string”, trying formats in order — email, URI, date-time, date, IPv4, IPv6, UUID; numbers use Number.isInteger to choose integer or number; booleans give boolean; objects recurse per key into properties. Options add attributes: required collects mandatory keys, examples records sample values (first two for arrays), descriptions generates notes, title generates a title, minMax adds minItems=0 for arrays, minLength=0 and maxLength=current length for strings, and minimum=0 for numbers ≥ 0 (otherwise −999999). Field counts accumulate recursively over properties and items, and the size is the serialized character count; the top-level $schema uses the draft URL for the selected version.
